changes.comment: sdk-ui-gen-ai: Dashboard links use persistent backend conversation IDs in their URLs so they reopen the originating conversation after reload. LinkHandlerEvent.conversationId remains the local conversation ID; dashboard and Publisher link events provide the backend ID separately in the new optional threadId field, also forwarded by web components. Publisher URLs continue to use the backend ID.
sdk-ui-gen-ai: Preserve local conversation IDs and cached conversation data when chat refresh selects the latest conversation.
sdk-ui-gen-ai: Preserve backend thread IDs in streaming and completion events when conversation metadata is refreshed.
